subject: Sparrow AI — pre-sales architecture playbook (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@sparrow.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@sparrow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sparrow AI — pre-sales architecture playbook (post-discovery)

Hi Aisha and Jordan,

Thanks again for the discovery yesterday — really helpful to understand Sparrow's inference throughput profile and the multi-tenant concerns you flagged. The team recommended we follow up with a short, focused "architecture playbook" session to align on:

- scope and success criteria for a proof-of-concept (throughput, latency SLOs)
- deployment topology options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. VPC)
- observability & rollout plan (debugging hooks, tracing, cost controls)

Proposed 90-minute options (all PDT):
- Tue Oct 20, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Oct 21, 13:00–14:30
- Thu Oct 22, 08:30–10:00

Attendees from our side: myself (solutions), Ben (pre-sales engineer), Priyom (integration/ops). If those windows are tight, tell us 2–3 slots that work for you and we'll try to accommodate.

I attached a short playbook outline so we can lock agenda items and pre-reads.

Agenda ask: if you have internal infra folks, please invite them — we'll keep the first 20 minutes to confirm architecture assumptions.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments: redwood-pre-sales-playbook-outline.pdf (1 page), sparrow-infra-checklist.xlsx (stub)

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@sparrow.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@sparrow.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sparrow AI — pre-sales architecture playbook (post-discovery)

Hi Vanessa — thanks, this looks good.

Quick notes:
- Our infra lead (Jordan) is only available mornings PT this week. He is traveling Tue afternoon through Thu morning.
- We prefer Wed morning or Fri morning if possible.
- For the agenda can we add a short item on data residency (SaaS vs. VPC) — our security team flagged some questions we want to surface.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed Oct 21, 09:00–10:30 (best)
- Fri Oct 23, 08:30–10:00 (backup)

If you can do Wed 09:00, Jordan and I will be there. I also attached a one-pager of our expected QPS distribution.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Head of Platform, Sparrow AI
aisha.khan@sparrow.ai

Aisha — Wed 09:00 PT works from our engineering side. I'll attend for the first half and hand over to Ben for the demo/handoff.

Couple logistical asks from infra:
- Can you confirm expected peak sequence length and any long-tail bursts? The QPS doc helps but we may need specific max token window to size batchers.
- Do you have an internal VPN/egress restriction that might affect a short smoke test from our hosted environment?

I've included a lightweight runbook (attached) and a notes column in the checklist for anything you want us to pre-configure. We'll plan 15 minutes of troubleshooting/late-run Q&A at the end.

I'll send a calendar invite once Vanessa confirms the final slot.

Thanks,
